initial_condition: An unpressurized demonstration faucet is fixed, and its initial and goal handle orientations are visually specified.
goal: Rotate the fixture-mounted faucet handle from its initial visible orientation to the specified visible goal orientation.
constraints: RGB-only object judgment; no calibration, simulator object state or historical motion targets.
One bounded action proposal per observation cycle; preserve execution limits and uncertainty latches.
Model visual claims and independently reviewed outcomes must be reported separately.
Use visually observed handle rotation; do not supply simulator qpos, target angle, axis or object position to the controller.
No liquid-flow claim follows from handle motion; no thread-turn criterion applies to this task.

steps.goal: Identify the specified objects, initial state and available RGB views; freeze the task variant.
Align a supported grasp with the handle and visible rotation clearance.
Close on the handle while the fixture remains stable.
Turn in bounded segments until the visually specified relative orientation is reached; verify fixture stability.
Release the supported handle and withdraw.
Verify the target handle orientation persists after gripper withdrawal.
